audit.why: EVEN / 5.5-10 against a 52.48% win rate over 909 games holds, and the chart's two Zoe rows at levels 1-2 are correctly justified: one 800-range bubble is a kill before your kit is whole.

audit.why: Portal Jump is a 575 blink for 1 second on 11/8/5s — spikes[1] and content mid both say so.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to say 6 gives her reach, not damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Sleepy Trouble Bubble denies Aurora's mobility outright — a sleeping Aurora cannot spend W or R, which is why a hop into the bubble is fatal rather than merely bad.
audit.why: Sleep is hard CC (kit flags hardCC) and Aurora's W and R are both dashes; the _missing file records this as rule dash-denied.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d rewritten to say the hop ends asleep.

notes: packet.defects lists three 'probable wrong ability names' — all FALSE POSITIVES. 'Land Sleepy Trouble Bubble', 'Paddle Star' and 'Portal Jump-R' are all Zoe's real ability names per the kit file (the last two are only flagged on punctuation: the real name carries a trailing '!', and 'Portal Jump-R' is the page's slot-suffix convention). No changes made on that basis. The _missing file also lists a 'resistances-invalidated' rule for Sleepy Trouble Bubble; Riot's text says sleep REDUCES magic resist rather than bypassing resistances, and the page already states the reduction correctly, so I did not add a bypass claim.
